finding: For every odd m, a unitary on C^(2m) with two full m-root spectral cosets cannot have an ONB of shifted pairs whose shifts lie in opposite residue classes and whose coset phase-products agree. The proof uses same-coset row unitarity and equal-vs-opposite odd-dimensional cross determinants; it gives an explicit paired-source obstruction for the ordinary n10 Fourier diagonal. For the alternative G6 cyclic complement, exact 299-orbit resultant certificates separately replayed exclude 5-spectral-value support, so any cyclic lift must have six simple eigenvalues and full v5 support. Both candidates remain unreviewed.
remaining_gap: Paired-basis exclusion does not cover arbitrary Fourier-product transversals. The new G6 cyclic complement may exist with simple full-support spectrum outside excluded two-coset cases; broken cyclic symmetry and general 1RQLS10 remain open.
next_action: Investigate the six-support cyclic Gram equations and whether the determinant mechanism applies to further physical spectral decompositions; continue constructive alternatives.
